page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz. The CPU allocation is designated as shared. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is delivered via three NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 144 GB of VRAM. This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning storage requirements must be met through external network-attached volumes. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data places this server in the top 10% tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance in the top 25% tier, with read-only large block speeds reaching 331.99 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations also rank in the top 10% tier, with Redis achieving 128.07 million operations per second.

For artificial intelligence workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier performance in LLM inference, processing 6061.83 tokens per second for prompt processing and 129.38 tokens per second for text generation using a medium 7B model. The high density of GPU resources and system memory relative to the shared CPU allocation offers a specialized hardware profile for machine learning, image processing, and parallel computing tasks, though the shared CPU model and lack of local storage represent key architectural tradeoffs.
description: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a KVM-based, GPU-accelerated server featuring an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with 32 shared vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration includes three NVIDIA L40S Ada Lovelace GPUs with a combined 144 GB of VRAM, while local storage is absent. In benchmark testing, this server ranks in the top 10% tier for single-core and multi-core CPU performance, database operations, and static web serving throughput. It also demonstrates top-tier efficiency in large language model inference, processing 6061.83 tokens per second for prompt processing on a 7B model. This profile is designed for parallel computing, machine learning inference, and memory-intensive database operations, balancing high-density GPU acceleration with a shared CPU model and network-only storage.
